claims.statement: UNESCO dates the dolmen tombs at Gochang, Hwasun and Ganghwa broadly to the first millennium BCE.
These cemeteries preserve hundreds of tombs assembled from large stone slabs.

evidence.note: 1000–1 BCE represents the source’s whole-millennium dating, not continuous construction or the date of any individual tomb. Three separated site groups are not represented by a single point.
